content.short: Loopring Subgraph provides real-time and historical insights from on-chain Loopring zkRollups.
content.description: Loopring Subgraph is an open-source indexing tool for on-chain data from Loopring's zkRollups. It lets developers parse zkRollup blocks dynamically without manual indexing, turning raw block data into structured records such as transactions, accounts, and balances. Delivered through a GraphQL API built on The Graph Protocol, it supports real-time and historical queries, making it possible to build dashboards and analytics for Loopring activity. This subgraph powers Loopring's block explorers with accessible, queryable data.
